conditions: 36 previously written English alternative visitor utterances, 12 previously written contextual follow-ups; bridge question examples authored independently of these evaluation strings. No independent real-visitor statistical validity.
conclusions: The 184-topic registry now exposes precise original historical document locators, not approval to answer.
The shared lexical router gains nine exact source navigations but still produces four incorrect proposed sources (all need confirmation).
The hybrid router safely refuses most of these unanticipated rephrasings, reaching the intended source only once; this is not user-level semantic retrieval.
All eight held-personal-answer-case utterances are refused by both routes; zero invented answers.
The testing set is assistant-authored and not representative. An independent set should precede performance claims.
Do not add 48 evaluation variants to the topic catalog as a shortcut, because that would invalidate held-out testing.
A future owner-authorized retrieval improvement should use source-aware rank/intent gates and adversarial cross-topic tests, followed by a new untouched test sample.
